name: Music player
summary: A compact player card: album art, title and artist, a waveform you can seek, elapsed and total time, previous, play and next, and volume.
use: in a media or podcast app
a11y: Seek and volume are native range inputs with names, and seek reads its time as "1:47 of 3:53"; play changes its name to Pause while playing, and the album art is decorative.

use_when: a now-playing card for one audio track, voice note or episode, docked beside other content
avoid_when: a list of tracks to choose from: use track-list
a list of podcast episodes: use podcast-episodes

parts.name: eyebrow
parts.what: where the track sits, such as side and track number

parts.name: seek
parts.what: a range input over a drawn waveform; the played part is filled

parts.name: transport
parts.what: previous, play or pause, and next

parts.name: volume
parts.what: volume slider, hidden on a phone

empty.how: with nothing queued, show a muted art square, 'Nothing playing' as the title and disable the transport

loading.how: the Smart UI renderer draws each marked slot as a quiet block of its size while the data arrives; the static file shows the filled part

error.how: if the track will not play, put a short message where the times are and offer Next

disabled.how: set disabled on Previous or Next at the start or end of the queue and style it with the muted text colour

overflow.how: on a phone the volume slider goes and the art gets smaller

long_text.how: artist and album are cut with an ellipsis; the title wraps
long_text.evidence: .odl-by span { overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; }

missing_image.how: the Smart UI renderer swaps a photo that fails to load for a block of the same size with its alt text

keyboard: Tab reaches Like, Seek, Previous, Play, Next, then Volume
Enter or Space presses the focused button; Play switches to Pause while playing
Arrow keys on Seek move by one second and update the time
Arrow keys on Volume change the level
